subject: Invoice delivery & entity split — Nordleaf billing contact and portal pilot
body:
From: Anna Barker <anna.barker@nordleaf.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@nordleaf.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Billing for acquired entity + delivery during portal pilot

Hi Jasmine,

We closed the acquisition of Solida Labs last week; AP asked me to confirm how Redwood can send invoices for the acquired entity (Solida Labs / Nordleaf group) while we migrate everything into our central portal. Two constraints from our side:

- We need separate invoice files for Solida Labs (legal entity) with its own VAT ID on the invoice.
- For the first two months we want email copies to payments@nordleaf.com while the portal enrollment completes, but ultimately the portal should be the canonical source.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Emit per-entity invoices with VAT breakdown and a reverse-charge marker when applicable,
2) Send email copies (PDF) during a 60-day pilot window, and
3) Provide a weekly CSV of invoice lines for our AP system (SFTP preferred)?

Also, what evidence do you need from us for EU VAT reverse charge? I can attach our VAT certificates.

Thanks — Anna
Anna Barker
AP Manager, Nordleaf Therapeutics
anna.barker@nordleaf.com

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Anna Barker <anna.barker@nordleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing for acquired entity + delivery during portal pilot

Hi Anna — congrats on the close, and thanks for the clear list. Short answers first, then next steps:

1) Yes — we can produce an invoice per legal entity and include VAT breakdowns and "reverse charge" notes when you have a valid EU VAT ID.

2) Email copies as PDF to payments@nordleaf.com during an initial pilot window (you suggested 60 days) — we can do that. We'll designate the portal as primary once enrollment completes; during the pilot PDF copies will be sent automatically and marked as "copy only" in the subject line.

3) Weekly CSV export over SFTP is supported — our Billing Ops team can provision an SFTP account and drop a weekly CSV with line-level detail (invoice_id, invoice_date, entity, net, vat, total, po_ref, charge_code).

What we need from you to proceed:
- VAT evidence for Solida Labs (attach certs) — PDF accepted.
- Preferred PO / remittance reference format for each entity (e.g. "NL-PO-12345" or a HubSpot deal id).
- SFTP hostname and username pattern (we can also provide an SSH key to simplify setup).

I attached a sample invoice PDF for formatting reference. Proposed next step: Ben (cc'd) will own mapping PO -> entity and Marissa will coordinate the portal enrollment timeline. If that sounds good I'll spin up the pilot agreement and schedule a 30-min technical handshake.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Attachment: sample-invoice-nordleaf.pdf

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Anna Barker <anna.barker@nordleaf.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing for acquired entity + delivery during portal pilot

Anna / Jasmine — quick note from Sales Ops on PO mapping and collections:

- We can accept PO references in the invoice and push that into our downstream invoicing system so AP sees the PO on the PDF and in the CSV. Please confirm the PO field format you want to surface (prefix vs free-text).
- For collections: if Nordleaf wants ACH (US) vs SEPA (EU), we typically include both bank details on the invoice and separate remittance instructions per entity. For Solida (EU), adding the IBAN and SEPA details is standard.
- If you plan to net the Solida invoices against Nordleaf parent invoices, let us know so we can enable multi-entity consolidation reports.

I'll pick up the PO mapping doc and send a template today.

Ben Carter
Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Barker <anna.barker@nordleaf.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing for acquired entity + delivery during portal pilot

Anna — a few notes from Billing/Compliance about VAT evidence and audit trail:

- For EU reverse charge we need a copy of the Solida Labs VAT certificate and a signed confirmation that the customer is responsible for reverse charge treatment on their VAT return. The VAT certificate must show the entity legal name and VAT number.
- We will include an audit footer in the invoice XML/CSV with invoice_hash and signer_id. If you require a signed PDF (e.g., for your legal records) we can provide a PKI-signed PDF for the first month.
- During the pilot window our system will mark PDFs as "Non-Authoritative — Portal Primary" in metadata so AP knows the portal contains the authoritative record.

Can you attach the VAT cert and confirm whether you want the PKI-signed PDF for the first invoice?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Manager — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

---

From: Anna Barker <anna.barker@nordleaf.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing for acquired entity + delivery during portal pilot

Thanks all — confirmed.

We will:
- Attach Solida_VAT_certificate.pdf to this thread (see attached).
- Use PO prefix format: "SOL-<PO#>" for Solida invoices.
- Accept email PDF copies during a 45-day pilot (shorter than my initial ask — we want to go-live quickly).
- Request the weekly CSV over SFTP at sftp://invoices.nordleaf-payments.example (username to be provided by our infra team later today).
- Please provide PKI-signed PDF for the first invoice for our records.

Next steps: Jasmine — can you share the pilot agreement and proposed handshake times? Ben — look forward to the PO mapping template. Marissa — please add portal enrollment to your queue; we'll prioritize Solida entity this week.

Best,
Anna
AP Manager — Nordleaf Therapeutics
anna.barker@nordleaf.com

Attachment: vat-certificate-nordleaf.pdf

-----END THREAD-----
